Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted a faulty search snippet that claimed “Seoul High School” is in “Seoul, Virginia, USA” and accepted it without verification. They failed to cross-check authoritative sources (e.g., the actual Wikipedia page or official school info) and ignored clear context cues (e.g., references to Seocho-gu and Seoul National University) indicating the school is in Seoul, South Korea. This led to the incorrect conclusion that both schools are in the same country.
